tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Walnut page ground behind every screen. Pair with `foreground` (13:1) and `muted-foreground` (4.7:1).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and headings on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `muted`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised panels: Card, dialogs' bodies, empty states. `foreground` reads 11.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside Card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, select lists, sheets.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside popovers and menus.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brass. Primary buttons, default badges, links, active states. Reads 6.6:1 as text on `background`, 5.6:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Dark ink on `primary` fills and on the brass `stat-plaque` (7.2:1 on `primary`).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and badges.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (8:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tab list track, hover fill for outline/ghost buttons, card footers at 50%.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting copy: descriptions, placeholders, inactive nav. 4.7:1 on `background`, 5.1:1 on `sidebar`. FLAG: only 4.0:1 on `card` and 3.6:1 on `muted` — below 4.5:1 for small text; kept exact from source.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and active fill for collection nav links and menu items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, delete actions (as a 10% tint behind destructive-colored text). FLAG: 3.1:1 on `background`, 2.6:1 on `card` — passes only for 24px+ text or icons; kept exact from source.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header rule, card footer rule, outline button and badge borders. Decorative (1.6:1), never the only cue.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text-field borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, applied at 50% opacity 3px wide around the focused control.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Darker walnut of the sidebar wood panel (`sidebar-wood`).

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar link text, at 70% when inactive.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Brass on the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Ink on brass within the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active and hover fill for top sidebar links.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Right edge of the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (brass).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (rust).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (oak).

tokens.name: chart-4

tokens.name: chart-5

tokens.name: shelf-dark
tokens.usage: Dark grain stops in the shelf plank gradient.

tokens.name: shelf-light

tokens.name: shelf-edge-top

tokens.name: shelf-edge-bottom

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brand brass: the wordmark, active tab text, sidebar active rule, rating stars.

tokens.name: brass-dark
tokens.usage: Sidebar section overlines ("Collection"). FLAG: 4.1:1 on `sidebar`, just under 4.5:1 for 12px text; kept exact.

tokens.name: leather
tokens.usage: Leather-bound accent surface (defined in source, reserved for accents).

tokens.name: leather-light
tokens.usage: Lighter leather accent.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Paper tone for page-like highlights.

tokens.name: cover-surface
tokens.usage: Fallback cover fill when an item has no artwork.

tokens.name: cover-initial

tokens.name: item-title-ink

tokens.name: item-meta-ink
tokens.usage: Media type line in the hover overlay.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the shelf cover's hover gradient.

tokens.name: vinyl-label
tokens.usage: Center label dot of the vinyl disc peeking from a sleeve.

tokens.name: page-edge-light
tokens.usage: Light stripe of a book's page edges.

tokens.name: page-edge-dark
tokens.usage: Dark stripe of a book's page edges.

tokens.name: auth-ground
tokens.usage: Deep ground behind the login and register screens (`auth-bg`).

tokens.name: plaque-1
tokens.usage: Stat plaque brushed-brass gradient, stop 1 (also stop 3: `plaque-3`).

tokens.name: plaque-2
tokens.usage: Stat plaque gradient, stop 2.

tokens.name: plaque-3
tokens.usage: Stat plaque gradient, stop 3.

tokens.name: plaque-4
tokens.usage: Stat plaque gradient, stop 4.

tokens.name: plaque-5
tokens.usage: Stat plaque gradient, stop 5.

tokens.name: plaque-border
tokens.usage: 1px border around a stat plaque.

tokens.name: status-completed
tokens.usage: Green glow ring: Completed and Watched (4.6:1 on `background`). Always pair with the ✓ glyph.

tokens.name: status-in-progress
tokens.usage: Blue glow ring: Reading and Watching (3.9:1). Pair with ▶.

tokens.name: status-wishlist
tokens.usage: Magenta glow ring: Wishlist and Want to Watch (3.9:1). Pair with ♡.

tokens.name: status-dropped
tokens.usage: Muted red ring at 70%: Dropped. FLAG: under 3:1 on `background`, and told from `status-completed` by hue more than lightness — always pair with ✕.

tokens.name: status-owned
tokens.usage: Soft brass ring at 50%: Owned (vinyl). Quietest status on purpose. Pair with ●.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: Dashboard, Search, Settings, Collection (24px below 640px). `foreground` on `background`.

styles.name: page-title-sm
styles.usage: Item detail title, mobile Collection title, and the auth card title in `brass`.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the logo mark, always `brass`.

styles.name: cover-initial
styles.usage: First letter of a title on a cover with no artwork, `cover-initial` on `cover-surface`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Here's an overview of your collection.
styles.usage: Default UI text: nav links, descriptions, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines in menus, timestamps; usually `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels: sidebar groups (`brass-dark`), stat plaque labels (`primary-foreground` at 70%). Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: The count on a stat plaque, `primary-foreground`.

styles.name: shelf-title
styles.usage: Title in a cover's hover overlay; fluid clamp(0.58rem, 1.2vw, 0.72rem), one line with ellipsis, `item-title-ink`.

styles.name: shelf-meta
styles.usage: Media type under the title; clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.62rem), `item-meta-ink`, capitalized.
